senses.gloss:
आटिः [आ-अट्-इण्]
—1 A kind of bird (शरारि) (also written आटि) cf. आटिराडी शराडी
 च शरारी राडिराडिका
—2 A sort of fish.
.━{@Comp.@}: आटिमुखः, आटिमुखम्

आटिः + -मुखः, -मुखम् a surgical instrument used in blood letting (so called
 from its being like the beak of the bird आटि).

आटिः + -मुखः, -मुखम् a surgical instrument used in blood letting (so called
 from its being like the beak of the bird आटि).

आटिक, आटिक्य a. [आटाय गमनाय प्रवृत्तः ठन्, ष्यञ्
 वा] Able to wander, being on a voyage or journey.

आटीकनम् [आटीक्-ल्युट्] The leaping motion of a calf; so आटीलकम्.
